contract.intent: Build the engine v1 — the 13 components (ann-system-design v3 §1) as a parallel task group: tree store, planner kernel, flow config, grilling/envision engines, context assembler, validators, runner reviewer, provider adapter, GitHub binding, human interface, renderers, eval harness. The build was transferred here verbatim from R5's original gate (closure-by-transfer, flow-control v3).
acceptanceCriteria: Engine v1 works: CLI (plan/run/tree/step/resume) per functional-spec F1-F17
K1-K5 measured on the fixture suite (K1 derived-accuracy 100% · K2 locate <=2 · K3 advance <=1 · K4 correctness >=95% · K5 first-pass completion >=85%)
Tree store implements tree-format-spec v5 (file ownership, write timing, event schema, gates, F-AC1-15)
Validators consume the rules registry (rules/check); resolver/journey/confirm/append absorbed from the seeds
Dogfooding round-trip: the engine manages this tree (F-AC8)
Failure signal armed: advance friction / wrong next-action / K5 below target = stop feature work
